tasks.short: Develop job placements and evaluate their success

steps.what: Contact prospective employers about job development and placement opportunities
Coordinate placements with clients and employers and agree practical support
Evaluate placement success with the client and employer after placement starts

tasks.design: Keep employer outreach, placement arrangements and evaluation with the counselor. Existing client goals in {DOCS} support discussion; no automatic job suitability ranking or placement decision is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A viable placement depends on the client, employer and practical support arrangements.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records can inform discussion without replacing relationship work.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve access needs and evaluate whether the placement works for the client.
tasks.human_edge: Build employer trust and hear the client's own account of the placement.
tasks.altitude: Placement responsibilities and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Clarify support needs without assuming a job is suitable.

evidence.claim: Placement coordination and success evaluation require contextual conversations; note-generation capability does not establish savings for that work.

assumptions: Boundary is counselor outreach, placement coordination and evaluation; formal hiring and separate case-note administration remain separately owned.
The client provides employment goals before s1 and preferences during s2; employers describe requirements during s1. No structured suitability flag is assumed.

Client and employer produce placement experiences only after the agreed placement begins, before or during s3. Their existing participation is unchanged outside the focal denominator; no new survey duty is transferred to them.
Native document access is sufficient. No new tool, capture duty or upkeep is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
unknowns: Placement authority and existing follow-up arrangements
research_questions: Which support issues most often disrupt otherwise suitable placements?

already_counted.description: Outreach, placement conversations and evaluation remain fully counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+35+30=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. No conversation or placement judgement is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Manage case-service budgets and authorise spending

steps.what: Gather budget balances and capture case service allocation requests
Calculate available budgets and the financial effect of proposed allocations
Direct case service allocations and authorize expenditures and payments within delegated limits

tasks.design: Configure native {ERP} budget views to calculate the effect of a captured case-service request. The counselor checks balances and commitments, decides allocations and authorises each exact spending instruction; payment execution stays in the existing finance process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Separate arithmetic can obscure commitments and create repeated manual calculations.
tasks.enabler_now: A native budget view can apply fixed arithmetic to checked amounts without deciding which client receives support.
tasks.still_hard: Prioritise needs fairly and resolve incomplete commitments or disputed charges.
tasks.human_edge: Make accountable service-allocation decisions and recognise the limits of delegated authority.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated arithmetic; the counselor retains allocation and authorisation responsibility.

reach.learn: Specify costs and distinguish posted expenditure from commitments.

evidence.claim: Fixed budget arithmetic can support human service allocation when inputs and commitments are checked; this design and saving are unmeasured model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary ends at the counselor's authorised instruction, excluding finance payment execution, original posting and the clinical service decision owned elsewhere.

Finance supplies budget identifier, period, opening allocation, posted transaction identifiers, amounts, currency, commitment identifiers and outstanding amounts from existing bookkeeping before s1. Leadership supplies current delegated limits. New source-quality checks cost 3 other-role hours per 100 focal baseline hours.

The counselor captures request identifier, case reference, proposed service, provider, amount, currency, timing and known unposted commitment adjustments during s1. That retained 30% includes manual reconciliation of missing or inconsistent records; uncertain inputs bypass automatic calculation.

s2 produces a versioned calculation with source snapshot, request version, balances and arithmetic. s3 verifies its meaning and decides service allocation; insufficient budget is a flag for a person, never an automatic eligibility decision.
Test native configuration before custom code. Already automated arithmetic earns no saving; the scenario requires current manual spreadsheet calculations.
Additional counselor upkeep is 7 hours per 100 baseline hours. No clinical or financial judgement is transferred to a machine.
unknowns: Reliability of commitments and delegated limits
Whether native budget views already remove manual arithmetic
research_questions: Can native views reproduce checked manual calculations including outstanding commitments?

already_counted.description: Input reconciliation remains in capture time.
Calculation verification and allocation and spending authorisation remain human.

incremental.description: Investigate calculation exceptions and review configuration.

approvals.approved_version: Exact request identifier and version, provider, service, amount, currency, timing, budget and calculation snapshot authorised in s3; any change voids authorisation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+0+50=80; gross=20, additional focal upkeep=7, central net=13. Conservative 2-7 assumes only part of manual arithmetic is removable because commitments often need clarification; service and payment authorisation retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with professionals about rehabilitation programmes

steps.what: Confer with professionals to develop and implement client rehabilitation programs

tasks.design: Keep multidisciplinary discussion and coordination with the counselor and relevant professionals. Existing authorised plans in {DOCS} support discussion; no automatic treatment recommendation or new meeting transcript is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Professionals must reconcile different perspectives and agree feasible responsibilities.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing record access can support discussion without replacing professional judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Balance the client's goals with clinical advice, practical constraints and professional responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge unclear advice and agree who will act on each concern.

reach.learn: Translate professional perspectives into clear, client-centred actions.

evidence.claim: Multidisciplinary rehabilitation planning remains contextual professional work, distinct from drafting a meeting note.

assumptions: Boundary is the counselor's contribution to professional discussion and coordination; separate documentation and direct treatment remain outside.
The client and existing care team supply goals and the current plan before s1; professionals produce advice during the discussion. No prior consensus or suitability flag is presumed.
Other professionals' existing participation remains unchanged outside the focal denominator. No new recording or capture work is added.
Native document access is sufficient; there is no new system or maintenance duty, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Which professionals hold programme decision authority
research_questions: Which unresolved responsibilities cause repeat multidisciplinary discussions?

already_counted.description: All counselor discussion and coordination remains.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. No professional conversation or coordination time is automated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Supervise rehabilitation counselors and staff through case discussion, guidance and follow-up

tasks.design: Keep staff supervision with the responsible counselor. Existing policies in {DOCS} remain references; no automated staff assessment or generated case decision is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision requires understanding the staff member's work and uncertainty.
tasks.enabler_now: Reference access does not replace coaching or accountability.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise when a concern requires support, escalation or closer oversight.
tasks.human_edge: Give useful feedback while maintaining a working relationship in which staff raise concerns.
tasks.altitude: Supervisory responsibility and staff authority stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Give specific feedback and distinguish learning needs from service risks.

evidence.claim: Professional supervision depends on contextual discussion and does not follow automatically from case-record availability.

assumptions: Boundary is direct supervision, excluding separate workforce scheduling, formal appraisal and case documentation.
Staff supply questions and case concerns during s1; the supervising counselor gathers work observations in that same retained time. No structured staff-risk or quality score is presumed.

Existing staff participation remains unchanged outside the focal denominator. Native reference access is sufficient; no new system, capture duty or upkeep is introduced, justifying zero incremental work.
unknowns: Supervisory remit and existing escalation arrangements
research_questions: Which concerns are staff least confident raising during supervision?

already_counted.description: All direct supervisory discussion and follow-up remains.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Human supervision remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The counselor keeps placement, rehabilitation and supervision decisions; checked native arithmetic may reduce budget calculation work.
reach: Clarify case-service cost inputs with support staff.
Coordinate practical rehabilitation responsibilities with healthcare social workers.
role.ambitious_version: Spend any released calculation time resolving difficult support arrangements while retaining accountable human decisions.
